snippet.title: Terminal Reign - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Operate a remote armoured vehicle for the glory and whims of a dying empire. Undertake tactical missions, configure your command desk with an array of devices, and remain in favour to survive. 

Coming 2027.
